patterns: PSC questions are direct: which state an outfit belongs to (ULFA = Assam), which conflict is in Manipur (Meitei vs Kuki, APPSC 2024), operation code names (Blue Star, APPSC 2025).
Language data questions (classical-language count, mother-tongue rank) attach to this topic - counts change, so keys date quickly.
App leans heavily on theory (primordialist/instrumentalist/constructivist, Oommen, Arnold Rose) - sociology depth rarely seen in APPSC PYQs.
AP tilt available: Andhra State 1953 as first linguistic state after Potti Sriramulu, Art. 371D.
